verdict.rationale: A note-taking app could plausibly ship an AI assistant that consumes tools from MCP servers, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or connecting to external tool servers. The general community plugin system and plugin-building docs are only developer building blocks, and the LLM plugins (Text-Generator, Copilot) are text-generation interfaces with no stated MCP tool use, so none of these earn credit.
